# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi
# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
"""Publish all nine closed worker samples and source-only follow-up packets."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import statistics

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/perf-native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-long-decode128-worker-repeat'
R = B / 'research-20261009'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('repeat_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')
prior_env = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())['environment']
for key in ['RUBYLIB', 'GEM_PATH']:
    ENV[key] = prior_env[key]


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')


def hashes(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: hashes(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [hashes(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-long-decode128-repeat-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    F.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], evidence={},
             main_reviewed=True, gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False)

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
                             rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=16 << 20, total_cap=48 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('source-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '4d0fb23095742615c698147cbe4212211a1b181f'
        assert not run('initial-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        samples, derivations, deletion = [], [], []
        reference = B / 'main-long-decode128-root-v5/sample-1-workers-5-gu-unchanged/xe-timed1-on/tokens.txt'
        for i, n in enumerate([5, 3, 4, 4, 3, 5, 3, 5, 4], 1):
            root = B / f'main-long-decode128-root-v5/sample-{i}-workers-{n}-gu-unchanged/xe-timed1-on'
            path = root / 'record.json'
            d = json.loads(path.read_text())
            assert d['passed'] and d['complete'] and not d['active']
            assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0
                       for c in d['commands'] + d['guard_commands'])
            assert d['performance_sample_eligible'] and d['kernel_gate_passed'] and d['boot_unchanged']
            assert d['model_normal_close'] and not d['quality_evaluated'] and not d['quality_qualified']
            assert d['qualification_sha256'] == '8bcf9db06bf6a1c8d47540284eed5319ad8ba8be9d217248a1bbe17d0737ec13'
            v = d['validation']
            assert v['prompt_tokens'] == 32768 and v['generated_tokens'] == 128 and v['finish'] == 'length'
            if i <= 4:
                public = Path('../2026-10-13-long-decode128-worker-screen/receipts') / f'sample-{i}-workers-{n}.json'
                assert (F / public).is_file()
            else:
                public = Path('receipts') / f'sample-{i}-workers-{n}.json'
                dump(F / public, hashes(d))
                derivations.append(dict(original_path=str(path), original_sha256=m.sha(path),
                                        public_path=str(public), public_sha256=m.sha(F / public),
                                        transformation='Typed SHA values; original status/receipt bytes unchanged.'))
                stderr_lines = (root / 'commands/engine.stderr').read_text().splitlines()
                retained = [line for line in stderr_lines if any(s in line for s in (
                    'memory guard:', 'weights loaded', 'native projection matrices', 'native pack:',
                    'KV streaming:', 'PLE table format', 'PLE on, table', 'experimental native',
                    'expert arena:', 'loaded 46.84 GiB', 'ranked pairs,', 'per-layer slots use',
                    'expert cache 144 slots', 'PER-LAYER:', 'pre-filled', 'expert-pool workers',
                    'GDN step forms', "PCIe share's fetch", 'BF16 GEMV', 'session is up',
                    'expert residency table', 'prompt path allocates', 'queue-completed',
                    'window up to', 'VRAM free', 'captured the 1-token', 'strata serve: prompt', 'hit rate:'))]
                dump(F / 'diagnostics' / f'sample-{i}.json', dict(selected_stderr_evidence=retained,
                     original_path=str(root / 'commands/engine.stderr'), sha256=m.sha(root / 'commands/engine.stderr')))
                for raw in sorted((root / 'commands').iterdir()):
                    if raw.is_file() and raw.suffix in ('.stdout', '.stderr'):
                        deletion.append(dict(path=str(raw), bytes=raw.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(raw),
                                             replacement=str(public), supplement=f'diagnostics/sample-{i}.json',
                                             reason='Closed request: protocol/ownership/provider/fault evidence recorded; redundant successful command logs or unrelated journal entries.'))
                token = root / 'tokens.txt'
                assert m.sha(token) == m.sha(reference) == d['input']['sha256']
                deletion.append(dict(path=str(token), bytes=token.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(token),
                                     replacement=str(reference), reason='Duplicate current32K input; keep one canonical32K copy, canonical64K parent and derivation.'))
            samples.append(dict(sample=i, workers=n, block=(i - 1) // 3 + 1,
                                prefill_ms=v['engine_prefill_ms'], decode_ms=v['engine_decode_ms'],
                                prefill_tps=32768000 / v['engine_prefill_ms'], decode_tps=128000 / v['engine_decode_ms'],
                                startup_seconds=d['startup_wall_seconds_observed'],
                                token_logprob_sha256=v['token_logprob_sha256'], receipt_path=str(public),
                                original_receipt_sha256=m.sha(path)))
        summary = {}
        for n in [3, 4, 5]:
            arm = [s for s in samples if s['workers'] == n]
            summary[str(n)] = dict(independent_samples=3)
            for phase, tokens in [('prefill', 32768), ('decode', 128)]:
                times = [s[phase + '_ms'] for s in arm]
                rates = [s[phase + '_tps'] for s in arm]
                summary[str(n)][phase] = dict(individual_ms=times, individual_tps=rates,
                    pooled_tps=3 * tokens * 1000 / sum(times), mean_tps=statistics.mean(rates),
                    median_tps=statistics.median(rates), min_tps=min(rates), max_tps=max(rates),
                    sample_stdev_ms=statistics.stdev(times), sample_cv_ms=statistics.stdev(times) / statistics.mean(times))
        paired = []
        for block in [1, 2, 3]:
            arms = {s['workers']: s for s in samples if s['block'] == block}
            paired.append(dict(block=block, decode_4_vs_3_time_ratio=arms[4]['decode_ms'] / arms[3]['decode_ms'],
                               decode_4_vs_5_time_ratio=arms[4]['decode_ms'] / arms[5]['decode_ms'],
                               prefill_4_vs_3_time_ratio=arms[4]['prefill_ms'] / arms[3]['prefill_ms']))
        dump(F / 'individual-samples.json', hashes(samples))
        dump(F / 'summary.json', dict(arms=summary, block_pairs=paired, adopted=False,
            complete_worker_matrix=True, statistical_optimum_claim=False, quality_evaluated=False,
            outliers_discarded=False, operational_failures=0,
            decision='Keep existing worker setting. Analyze prefill/decode independently; three samples do not remove decode variability.'))
        dump(F / 'receipt-derivations.json', derivations)
        reports = ['research-native-copy-queue-urv2-owner-event-path-round332-v1.txt',
                   'research-persistent-prefill-allocation-owner-alias-ledger-round333-v1.txt',
                   'implementation-phase-decode-cache-owner-source-v2.txt',
                   'implementation-prefill-native-copy-queue-source-v2.txt']
        entries = []
        for name in reports:
            path = R / name
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, dict(original_path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size, text=path.read_text()))
            entries.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        prior = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-long-decode128-worker-screen/report-registry-v177.json'
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v178.json', dict(research_completed=json.loads(prior.read_text())['research_completed'] + len(entries),
             prior=dict(path='../2026-10-13-long-decode128-worker-screen/report-registry-v177.json', sha256=m.sha(prior)),
             new_reports=entries, main_only_test_execution=True, all_new_implementations_source_only=True))
        packets = []
        for name in ['main-phase-decode-cache-owner-source-v2', 'main-prefill-native-copy-queue-source-v2']:
            root = B / name
            patch = root / 'changes.patch'
            target = F / 'source-packets' / (name + '.patch')
            target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text('# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi\n# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later\n\n' + patch.read_text())
            manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
            dump(F / 'source-packets' / (name + '.json'), hashes(dict(original_path=str(manifest), sha256=m.sha(manifest), data=json.loads(manifest.read_text()))))
            packets.append(dict(path=str(root), status='source-only', adopted=False,
                original_patch_sha256=m.sha(patch), archived_patch=str(target.relative_to(F)), archived_patch_sha256=m.sha(target),
                transformation='SPDX prelude added to original unified patch; before revision and all original after hashes retained.',
                consumer='Main review, isolated builds and qualified CPU/tinyGPU fixtures', owner='Main',
                byte_budget=512 << 10, next_review='After qualification or replacement packet'))
        dump(F / 'source-packets.json', packets)
        rows = '\n'.join(f"| {s['sample']} | {s['workers']} | {s['prefill_tps']:.3f} | {s['decode_tps']:.4f} |" for s in samples)
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text('''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Repeated32K-input,128-token worker comparison

Arc B57010GiB, Ryzen5600X, free build/sourceLLVM7.1.1, same qualified binary,
ordinary persistent serve, noMTP, segmented handoff, int8KV32768resident,
context262144,144profile-filled expert slots,18tasks,8192prefill, greedy.
Nine fresh-process samples complete the predeclared5,3,4,4,3,5,3,5,4order.
Each worker count has three individual samples, retained without outlier removal.

| Sample | Workers | Prefill tok/s | Decode tok/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
''' + rows + '''

All nine requests are complete, finite, normally closed with QUIT, observed and
reaped with empty owned sessions, fresh health/provider checks, unchanged boot
and no relevant kernel/device fault. All reported128token/LP5 fingerprints happen
to match. Quality remains unevaluated: neither equality nor differing free-running
strings are general quality acceptance. Input/binary/source/env/commands and
individual times stay pinned in the receipts. Startup is separate.

The complete matrix still has decode variability. summary.json records pooled,
mean/median/range and sample variation, with within-block paired time ratios.
No worker setting is adopted or claimed optimal. Prefill/decode remain separate
decisions; a fast phase does not justify a regression in the other phase. The
slow first worker5 sample remains valid evidence, not silently discarded.

R332 uncovered ambiguous rawUR borrower cleanup if SYCL queue construction
throws after native import. The new copy packet fail-stops before owners unwind
and before a live imported queue can be destroyed on insertion failure. It does
not repair or qualify URinternals. Shared production CPU failure seams and the
tinyGPU source still need Main build/lint/sanitizer/provider/role/event checks
before any model treatment. DefaultOFF remains the proposal's default.

R333 identifies Gemm lazy tc_w/tc_x buffers outside Prefill::owned/bytes_needed;
reset destroys that owner after drains. Actual freed bytes need measurement.
The phase-cache owner packet implements checked actualVMM storage/reader
bookkeeping and fault fixtures but is not wired into persistent serve yet. A
separate caller implementation is in progress; no cache-growth engine, speed
gain, quality, RESTORE or full262144-input result is claimed.

New source-only unified patches and hashes are archived for durable review.
Raw logs and duplicate inputs for the five newly closed samples are retired only
after useful evidence is verified. Original private receipts remain byte-identical
for current provenance/prefix consumers. Source packets/model/state fixtures stay
under named finite consumers; the retention manifest records every deletion.
Next: isolated free/contrib-llvm build, CPU ownership/sanitizer checks and small
debugGPU qualification for the native copy queue; then quiet>=32K comparison.
The1000prefill/70decode objective and optimized official/fullcontext/quality
comparisons remain open.
''')
        dump(F / 'controllers' / (Path(__file__).name + '.json'), dict(sha256=m.sha(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', dict(deletions=deletion, planned=True, deleted=False,
             active_runs_touched=False, pinned_private_receipts_retained=True, byte_budget=8 << 20,
             owner='Main', consumer='Current v5 source/admission and nine-sample comparison receipts',
             next_review='After replacement measurement controller is qualified'))
        paths = [str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        lint = run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *paths])
        assert 'skipped (' not in lint
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check', 'HEAD'])
        for item in derivations:
            assert m.sha(Path(item['original_path'])) == item['original_sha256']
            assert m.sha(F / item['public_path']) == item['public_sha256']
        for item in deletion:
            path = Path(item['path'])
            assert path.stat().st_size == item['bytes'] and m.sha(path) == item['sha256']
        for item in deletion:
            Path(item['path']).unlink()
        manifest = json.loads((F / 'retention-manifest.json').read_text())
        manifest.update(planned=False, deleted=True, removed_file_count=len(deletion),
                        removed_logical_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in deletion), free_space_claim=False)
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', manifest)
        run('stage-report', ['git', 'add', '--', str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit-report', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'perf(bench): preserve repeated long-decode worker comparison'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push-report', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'perf/native-copy-cohorts-qualified-20261012'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'commit']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
